cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 87% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.38% · WTI +1.46% · Brent +1.78% · NatGas +1.82%. 87% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +5.08%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.08%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.18%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: OKLO is the standout at +7.53%
cards.body: Leaders: OKLO +7.53%, BE +7.44%, VRT +6.07%, TLN +5.76%, EOSE +5.70%. Laggards: ETR -0.97%, NEE -0.67%, MPLX -0.19%.
